name: scope-panels
title: Scope Panels
description: Connected members, files and pending-invitation panels for any membership scope, for apps without Console Kit.
docs: `scope-panels` installed `ScopeAccessProvider`, `ScopeAccessPanel {scope, entityId?}`, `ScopeFilesPanel {scope, entityId?}` and `PendingInvites` under `src/blocks/scope-access`. Put `ScopeAccessProvider host={{ endpoints: { admin, auth, data }, userId, getAccessToken }}` around the signed-in app. `scope` is a `membershipTypes.scope` name (`app`, `org`, `data_room`); every scope but `app` needs the entity's id. RLS and capabilities decide what each user sees and may change.
